blocks.text: The parents of Chinese volunteer teachers in Philippine schools have asked that they return home for their safety after suspicions were raised about their true intentions in the country, Beijing’s embassy in Manila and the Federation of Filipino-Chinese Chambers of Commerce and Industry Inc. (FFCCCII) said on Saturday. The request for the teachers’ recall, the latest manifestation of the fraying ties between Manila and Beijing rooted in their maritime dispute, was approved by both FFCCCII and the Chinese Embassy, the federation said in a statement to the Inquirer.
